1.web: The Spirit of God came on Azariah the son of Oded:
1.asv: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded:

2.web: and he went out to meet Asa, and said to him, “Hear me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin! Yahweh is with you, while you are with him; and if you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will forsake you.
2.asv: and he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin: Jehovah is with you, while ye are with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.

3.web: Now for a long time Israel was without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law.
3.asv: Now for a long season Israel was without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law:

4.web: But when in their distress they turned to Yahweh, the God of Israel, and sought him, he was found by them.
4.asv: but when in their distress they turned unto Jehovah, the God of Israel, and sought him, he was found of them.

5.web: In those times there was no peace to him who went out, nor to him who came in; but great troubles were on all the inhabitants of the lands.
5.asv: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in; but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the lands.

6.web: They were broken in pieces, nation against nation, and city against city; for God troubled them with all adversity.
6.asv: And they were broken in pieces, nation against nation, and city against city; for God did vex them with all adversity.

7.web: But you be strong, and don’t let your hands be slack; for your work shall be rewarded.”
7.asv: But be ye strong, and let not your hands be slack; for your work shall be rewarded.

8.web: When Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominations out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from the hill country of Ephraim; and he renewed the altar of Yahweh, that was before the porch of Yahweh.
8.asv: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominations out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from the hill-country of Ephraim; and he renewed the altar of Jehovah, that was before the porch of Jehovah.

9.web: He gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and those who lived with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance, when they saw that Yahweh his God was with him.
9.asv: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and them that sojourned with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance, when they saw that Jehovah his God was with him.

10.web: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
10.asv: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.

11.web: They sacrificed to Yahweh in that day, of the plunder which they had brought, seven hundred head of cattle and seven thousand sheep.
11.asv: And they sacrificed unto Jehovah in that day, of the spoil which they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.

12.web: They entered into the covenant to seek Yahweh, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul;
12.asv: And they entered into the covenant to seek Jehovah, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul;

13.web: and that whoever would not seek Yahweh, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
13.asv: and that whosoever would not seek Jehovah, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.

14.web: They swore to Yahweh with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.
14.asv: And they sware unto Jehovah with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.

15.web: All Judah rejoiced at the oath; for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and Yahweh gave them rest all around.
15.asv: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath; for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and Jehovah gave them rest round about.

16.web: Also Maacah, the mother of Asa the king, he removed from being queen, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah; and Asa cut down her image, and made dust of it, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.
16.asv: And also Maacah, the mother of Asa the king, he removed from being queen, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah; and Asa cut down her image, and made dust of it, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.

17.web: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
17.asv: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.

18.web: He brought into God’s house the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.
18.asv: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.

19.web: There was no more war to the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.
19.asv: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.
